title: Figures 25-26: FDL ASSET flight-tested glider and heat pipe shuttle leading edge test
description: Two color photographs. Left: a recovered ASSET glider with labeled material panels such as "Columbium," "TZM Molybdenum" and "ATJ Graphite"; caption: "Figure 25. FDL ASSET Flight-Tested From Orbital Speeds To Evaluate 1960s' Materials. Carbon leading edges proved the least durable." Right: a glowing heat-pipe leading edge under radiant heating; caption: "Figure 26. Heat Pipe Shuttle Leading Edge Designed and Built by McDonnell Douglas Astronautics. Tested extensively at McDonnell Douglas Corporation, St. Louis, and NASA Langley, it never failed."
